title: Short Interest & SEC Filings Scraper input

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: short-interest = Nasdaq's bi-monthly short interest history per ticker. short-volume = FINRA's daily short-sale volume for every US symbol. filings = a company's SEC filing history. filing-search = full-text search across all EDGAR filings. company = SEC company profile. reference = check all sources live, including the newest FINRA date available.
enumTitles: short-volume - FINRA daily short volume (all symbols)
filings - SEC filing history for a company
reference - which sources are live + newest data date

symbol.title: Ticker or CIK
symbol.description: A single ticker (TSLA) or, for SEC modes, a CIK number. Case does not matter and a leading $ is ignored.

symbols.title: Tickers or CIKs
symbols.description: Several tickers (or CIKs for SEC modes) in one run. In short-volume mode this filters the daily file down to the symbols you list; leave it empty to get every symbol.

date.title: Date (short-volume mode)
date.description: Trading day in YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to use the newest file FINRA has published - it runs 1-2 days behind and never publishes on weekends or market holidays.

dates.title: Dates (short-volume mode)
dates.description: Several trading days in YYYY-MM-DD to pull in one run.

venue.title: Venue (short-volume mode)
venue.description: Which FINRA file to read. 'consolidated' covers all venues and is what most analyses want; the others isolate a single reporting facility.

forms.title: Form types (filings and filing-search modes)
forms.description: Filter to specific SEC form types, e.g. 8-K, 10-Q, 10-K, 4, SC 13D. Leave empty for every form.

since.title: Filed since (filings mode)
since.description: Only return filings on or after this date, in YYYY-MM-DD.

query.title: Search query (filing-search mode)
query.description: Full-text query across EDGAR documents. Wrap a phrase in double quotes for an exact match, e.g. "reverse stock split".

startDate.title: Start date (filing-search mode)
startDate.description: Earliest filing date to search, in YYYY-MM-DD.

endDate.title: End date (filing-search mode)
endDate.description: Latest filing date to search, in YYYY-MM-DD.

assetClass.title: Asset class (short-interest mode)
assetClass.description: Nasdaq's asset class for the symbol: stocks or etf.

includeSymbolInfo.title: Include exchange info (short-interest mode)
includeSymbolInfo.description: Adds company name, exchange and listing status to every short interest row. Costs one extra request per ticker.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum records per run. A single FINRA day holds about 12,300 symbols, so raise this when pulling a whole file.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. All three sources answered every request without a proxy.
